correctness.rationale: All 28 candidate bitangents follow from three exact polynomial square identities and signed-permutation symmetry. Their distinctness is checked symbolically for every smooth parameter, and the classical 28-bitangent theorem makes the list complete. Any common field must contain the axis slope s and the mixed coefficient a, hence b=(1+a)/s: this proves minimality rather than just a field bound. Independent square-class valuations at lambda=-1,-2 prove generic V4, and explicit automorphisms, rational-map derivative, and real radical signs give all additional statements. The attached SymPy verifier was executed successfully from its actual packaged source path; the standard 28-line theorem and valuation arguments are proved/referenced separately rather than inferred from finite experiments.

originality.rationale: The inspected Janasz–Pokora–Zieliński §3 addresses the complex intersection census for three special pencil members, not common arithmetic fields, rationality or the Galois cover. Bethea–Brazelton §4 computes complex automorphism orbits and explicitly credits the Edge parametrization, and Bruin–Lewis studies general descent for quartics having rational bitangents. The historical parametrization itself is fully treated as prior work. No complete equality of the minimal common bitangent field, generic and specialized Galois profile, branch locus and rationality iff criterion was found in the inspected full texts, actual semantic-index searches or the inspected mathematical literature. Residual risk: Edge §14 cannot be fully inspected and might imply or contain arithmetic consequences.
residual_risks: Historical Edge (1938) §14 has exact same parameter family; its full text was unavailable, and it could state or imply additional arithmetic conclusions not visible in secondary citations. The parameter formula and geometric bitangent presentation are not claimed as new.
Earlier, unindexed algebraic-arithmetic studies of octahedral/Ciani quartics may formulate the same biquadratic field under another representation.
A self-review is not external mathematical audit or a certification of novelty.

value.rationale: The simultaneous field of definition of all 28 odd-theta bitangents is a natural arithmetic invariant, crucial to whether techniques requiring rational bitangents apply. The finding classifies that field for every rational member, gives a complete parametrization of the rational-bitangent subfamily, identifies the generic degree-four Galois local system and its three branching parameters, and calculates all real regimes. This is a complete and reusable arithmetic classification of an entire intrinsic pencil, not just a selected example or a formula for known lines.
